facts: About 61,000 people (2011), the largest settlement in Northern Cyprus
The northern part of the divided city of Nicosia
worth_knowing: Nicosia was divided into Greek and Turkish Cypriot quarters by the Green Line, named for the colour of the pen a United Nations officer used to draw it on a map.
